name: Broccoli Salad
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 7–8 slices of crisp fried bacon, crumbled (smoked bacon works well)
1 red or sweet onion, chopped (Vidalia are recommended)
1 cup (80 g / 2.8 oz) raisins, plumped in boiling water
½ cup (110 g / 3.9 oz) granulated sugar (or equivalent artificial sweetener)
½ cup (40 g / 1.4 oz) pecans or sunflower seeds
dash of cider vinegar or lemon juice

steps: Whisk mayonnaise, sugar, and vinegar together.s
Mix remaining ingredients and combine completely in a large bowl.
Cool in the refrigerator overnight before serving.

culture.text: A salad is a dish consisting of mixed ingredients, frequently vegetables. They are typically served chilled or at room temperature, though some can be served warm. Condiments called salad dressings, which exist in a variety of flavors, are usually used to make a salad.
